credited_prior_work.scope: Original crossed biform coefficient construction; retained attribution.

The exact seven-point binary full-rank certificate and dimension-intersection argument are credited prior work. This package lifts that compact certificate to an everywhere-full-rank rational three-space and deduces the sharp rational rank14 family cap. Prior geometric conventions and dimension-source pins are also retained.

local_work: Explicit universal integer determinant identity via an SL2-by-SL2 dense normal form and bounded three-variable parity-block calculation; exact factor alternative for geometrically bounded-rank linear spaces; elementary rederivation of the classical dimension-six bound for geometrically singular 3x3 coefficient spaces; rational lifting of the merged binary full-rank three-space, giving the sharp dimension-six rational source-rank14 family bound.
field_and_hypotheses: The cleared polynomial identity is over Z and specializes in all characteristics. The invariant rank criterion and factor alternative require characteristic different from two. The singular-coefficient-space bound is geometric in every characteristic. The sharp source-rank14 family bound is over Q; every nonzero member of the explicit rational three-space has rank15. The general factor reduction guarantees an invertible coefficient member over the algebraic closure, and over the original field if infinite.
finite_evidence: 29 exact rational coefficient matrices replaying five named and 24 seed-20261023 scratch inputs; three additional rational full-rank-three-space controls with separate denominator clearing and mod-two normalization; 18 reductions of six integer inputs over F3/F5/F7; one F2 full-rank boundary; symbolic Edwards parity-block determinants of sizes eight and seven. The extra modular input diag(1,3,1) isolates source rank loss with invertible coefficients over F7. Nine focused tests. No nine-variable symbolic 15x15 determinant, prior-verifier import, or binary census rerun.
discovery_boundary: The two scratch proofs and exact controls were produced in the same generating session. Their hashes record provenance, not independent review. The maintained verifier reconstructs the literal source and checks bounded controls. The universal identity and dimension consequence rely on the written proofs, not sampled agreement.
prior_credit: The orthogonal correspondence and dimension facts retain their external attribution. The singular 3x3-space cap is explicitly a classical special-case rederivation. No historical-priority claim is made for the determinant formula or other invariant theory.
limitations: No irreducibility assertion for the degree-twelve factor, equality classification, geometric source-rank14 dimension-six bound over arbitrary fields, characteristic-two replacement for the invariant criterion, compatible tensor construction, degeneration or exponent improvement. The rational bound does not settle the algebraically closed field case. No torsion/Mazur or unmerged attainment dependency.
